sheets.name: Start
consts: Cartafella Analytics Consultancy & Solutions WLL  ·  Doha, Qatar  ·  Version 1.0  ·  November 2026

The workbook ships with fictional sample rows (Client A…H, Example Candidate 01…, Consultant 01…) so every chart works on day one. Client, consultant, employee and contract IDs follow the Finance dashboard sample masters. None of it is real data.

Clear sample data: on Requirements, Candidates, Onboarding, Deployments and Activity Log, filter Data flag = EXAMPLE, select the yellow input cells of the visible rows and press Delete (keep the grey formula columns). Then replace the EXAMPLE clients and recruiters on Settings with your own and remove their Data flag.

One place to run and follow every recruitment and outsourcing job for Cartafella Analytics – from the client requirement to the paid invoice or monthly billing – with each step dated, owned, measured against an SLA and logged, so you can see the HR process and its updates step by step.
How to update – step by step
Requirements › add a row with a new Requirement ID (REQ-YYYY-NNN), client, service type, role and positions. Stage = Requirement received.
Each time it moves, change Stage and Stage date. Keep Next action / owner / due date current.
Candidates › one row per candidate with the Requirement ID. Enter the date of each step as it happens – stage, days in stage and SLA are automatic.
Onboarding › open a row and tick each checklist item Done / Pending / N/A until complete.
Enter the Joined date. Recruitment: the 30-day guarantee and fee status run automatically. Outsourcing: add the person on Deployments with the Finance Employee ID and Contract ID.
Deployments › mark Timesheet and Invoice for each active person; watch the renewal alerts.
Activity Log › one line per update (date, record ID, what changed, by whom). The Dashboard shows the latest 12.
Dashboard › choose Year and Month. Check the Attention list daily and Recruiter Performance weekly.

sheets.name: Process Map
consts: HR Process Map – Step by Step
The standard path for every requirement, who owns each step, the SLA, the documents and where to record it in this workbook
SLA days link to Settings – change them there. Qatar notes are general guidance only: government procedures change, so the PRO / HR must confirm the current requirements for each case before acting.
Capture the client need: role, positions, salary budget, location, start date and fee terms.
Client requirement e-mail or form; signed fee agreement / terms
Agree the job description, must-have skills and interview process with the client.
Search the database, job portals, LinkedIn and referrals; contact candidates.
Search log; candidate consent to be represented
Screening call: experience, salary expectation, notice period, availability and visa / transfer status.
Check if the candidate is in Qatar and whether a transfer / NOC is relevant.
Send formatted CVs with recruiter notes to the client (only with candidate consent).
Schedule interviews, brief the candidate, collect feedback within 48 hours.
Agree salary and benefits; client issues the offer.
Candidate signs the offer; confirm notice period and joining date.
Candidates → Offer accepted; Onboarding → new row
Collect documents and run the employer onboarding steps until the candidate can join.
Passport, photos, attested certificates, medical, visa, QID
Onboarding → checklist; Candidates → Visa docs started
Work visa / entry, medical, biometrics and QID run through the official Qatar government channels; the employer (client or the Company) sponsors. Confirm current steps with the PRO.
Confirm the joining date in writing with the client.
Candidates → Joined date (Outcome stays Active until paid)
Monitor the placement during the guarantee window; if the candidate leaves, replace per the agreement.
Candidates → Guarantee status (automatic); Outcome = Replacement needed if triggered
Finance raises the placement invoice on the agreed trigger (joining or end of guarantee).
Candidates → Invoiced date + Placement invoice no (same no as Finance)
Payment received and matched in Finance; close the candidate as Placed.
B.  Outsourcing / staff augmentation (Staff Augmentation, IT Outsourcing, Managed Services, EOR, COR)
Capture headcount, roles, duration, location, working hours and service scope.
Requirements → new row (Service type = outsourcing line)
Prepare the commercial proposal and monthly rate card; Regional Manager approves pricing.
Proposal; rate card (salary, visa, medical, accommodation, transport, insurance, margin)
Requirements → Stage = Proposal / rate card sent
Sign the contract or SOW and receive the PO; Finance creates the Contract ID.
Source, screen and shortlist candidates as in the recruitment process.
Client interviews / approves the resource; issue the employment offer.
Client approval; offer; employment contract draft
Candidates → Client interview, Offer made, Offer accepted
Visa, medical, biometrics, QID, labour contract, insurance, bank / payroll, accommodation, PPE / IT assets, induction.
Employment contract registered through the Ministry of Labour system (formerly ADLSA); salaries paid through the Wage Protection System (WPS). Confirm current steps with the PRO.
Resource starts at the client site; set up timesheet approver.
Deployments → new row (Employee ID = Finance EMP-NNN); Candidates → Joined, Outcome = Deployed
Collect the client-approved timesheet at month end.
Finance raises the monthly invoice against the Contract ID and follows up payment.
Deployments → Invoice this month, Last invoice no / date
Act on 90/60/30-day alerts: renew, extend or plan exit and final settlement.
Deployments → Contract end date / Exit date; Activity Log
On exit, final settlement (end-of-service, leave, ticket) and residence permit cancellation follow the employment contract and current regulations – confirm with HR / PRO.

sheets.name: Recruiter Performance
consts: Activity and conversion per recruiter for the Dashboard period; SLA and overdue counts are as at today.

Notes: Offer acceptance % = offers made in the period that were accepted ÷ offers made in the period. Shortlist → interview % = shortlists sent in the period that reached client interview.
